title: Driving Simulator
description: Developed a VR-based driving simulator for training purposes using Unity. The simulator includes realistic vehicle physics, traffic environments, and user interaction through VR controllers for immersive driving practice.

title: MR BTECH Electronics Training Modules
description: Developed mixed reality (MR) training modules for B.Tech electronics students, enabling interactive learning of electronic components, circuits, and lab procedures through immersive visualization.

title: VR Lathe Machine Training
description: Developed an immersive VR lathe machine simulator to train users on machining operations including cutting, shaping, and finishing processes with realistic machine controls and safety procedures.

title: Crane Simulator
description: Designed a virtual reality crane operation simulator allowing users to learn safe crane handling, load lifting, and positioning techniques within a simulated industrial environment.

title: Advanced VR Welding Simulator
description: A highly detailed VR welding training simulator featuring realistic welding physics, multiple welding techniques, material interaction, and safety training for industrial applications.

title: Fire Safety Training
description: A VR module that simulates emergency fire scenarios, teaching users how to identify hazards, use fire extinguishers, and safely evacuate through guided training steps.

title: Screwing Process Training
description: An interactive training experience where users learn and perform step-by-step screwing operations using virtual tools in a controlled, immersive environment.

title: Terminal Fixing
description: This module trains users on correctly placing and securing terminal components in assemblies processes, ensuring precision and safety during the process.

title: Holder Fixing
description: A VR simulation focused on fixing holders into Workpiece, guiding users through part handling, alignment, and secure fitting procedures.

title: UNO Minda Die Casting Training
description: A VR industrial training module that teaches operators the die casting process including material handling, mold operation, and safety procedures inside a simulated manufacturing environment.

title: UNO Minda Leakage Testing
description: A VR training module designed to teach operators how to perform leakage testing procedures on casting components, identify defects, and safely operate leakage testing machines.

title: UNO Minda Painting Process
description: Simulates the industrial painting workflow for casting components, training operators on proper handling, coating procedures, and quality inspection inside a virtual environment.

title: UNO Minda PDI Inspection
description: A VR training module for Pre-Delivery Inspection (PDI) that helps users learn inspection procedures, defect detection, and quality verification for casting components.

title: UNO Minda Plug-In Process
description: An immersive VR simulation where users learn the plug-in assembly process including component placement, alignment, and secure fitting procedures in an industrial workflow.

title: UNO Minda VMC Operation
description: A virtual reality training simulator that teaches operators how to work with Vertical Machining Centers (VMC), including machine setup, machining workflow, and safety practices.

title: 3D Chess Game
description: Multiplayer 3D chess game using Unity and Blender. Implemented server-client architecture in .NET for online multiplayer and used OOP principles for maintainable code.

title: Tagore Hostel (FPS Game)
description: Developed a first-person shooting game in Unreal Engine, creating a detailed environment and interactive shooting mechanics.

title: +1 Dimension
description: Built a virtual reality property exploration system with customizable room layouts and AR visualization using marker-based technology.

title: Spotify Clone
description: AM Music App is a Kotlin-based music streaming platform using Jetpack Compose, Spotify API integration, and Firebase.

title: IIT Jodhpur Navigational Mapping
description: Developed an AR-based campus navigation system for IIT Jodhpur using Unity, ARCore, and Flutter.

title: Quiz Game
description: Interactive 3D quiz game in Unity using C#, Blender, and Firebase.

title: Flappy Bird
description: 2D mobile game in Unity with custom physics and Firebase leaderboard.
